title: Big picture, round 3: inside the main page, folded, app look

steps.path: Big picture tab: where the four views live now
steps.headline: The four views move into the main page's Big picture tab, as four small tabs.
steps.changed: No separate page any more. Big picture, next to Today and Screens, now has a second row of tabs: Areas, Journeys, Foundations, How it works. Areas is the view the tab already had.
steps.notice: One page, one look, one side panel. Switching views no longer reloads a different page.
steps.risk: Areas is unchanged from before, so its statuses are still a dot and a word while the other three use the app's tinted status pills. The old separate page still exists as a file, but nothing links to it.

steps.path: Big picture → Journeys, as it opens
steps.headline: Journeys: one folded line per journey, with how far it gets.
steps.changed: Each journey is one row: its name, where it stops, and a pill like "5 of 7 steps work". Under them, "What stops them" lists the unbuilt things more than one journey needs.
steps.notice: The whole view fits on one screen without opening anything. No boxes in a row, no hatching.

steps.path: Big picture → Journeys, one journey opened, one step clicked
steps.headline: Opened: one row per step, and a click opens the same side panel as everywhere else.
steps.changed: Steps are numbered rows with a status pill; the step it stops at says "stops here". Clicking a step opens the side panel.
steps.notice: This is how it ties to the other tabs: the side panel shows "Where it shows up" (pictures from the Screens tab; click one to open it) and "Work on those screens" (the work from Today).
steps.risk: Round 2's picture was a different click (a step in another journey).

steps.path: Big picture → Foundations, as it opens
steps.headline: Foundations: "Build next" first, everything else folded into three lists.
steps.changed: The building with floors and lines is gone. On top, the five unbuilt things that would unblock the most. Below, three folded lists: Ready to start, Waiting on something, Already exist. Stand-alone items are folded by area at the bottom.
steps.notice: The answer to "what should be built next" is the first thing you read.

steps.path: Big picture → Foundations, a list opened and an item clicked
steps.headline: Opened: each item says what it waits on, in words.
steps.changed: "Waiting on something" opens inside its own box; each row reads "Waits on: …". The clicked item opens the side panel, with its screens.
steps.notice: Nothing is cut off and no lines cross the text.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works, as it opens
steps.headline: How it works: the three paths first, then the parts as folded rows.
steps.changed: The diagram is replaced by lists. "Follow a path" (a message, an install, a sync) comes first, then the parts in three groups: parts of the app, outside services, parts not built yet.
steps.notice: Every part has a one-line description and a status pill without opening it.
steps.risk: You lose the picture of boxes and arrows. If you liked seeing the shape, say so and it can come back as one picture inside this view.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works, one part opened
steps.headline: Opened: what it talks to, and the ideas that rest on it.
steps.changed: A part opens inside its own box: what it is made of, "Talks to" (each connection in one sentence), "Ideas that rest on this" (click one for the side panel), and "Where the code lives" folded.
steps.notice: The "Mesh" hover hints are gone; names explain themselves.
